regime_montecarlo_decision.summary: A hidden Markov model learns the market's regimes and tracks the current one bar by bar; a Monte Carlo simulation runs the current regime forward; Kronos forecasts the next candles; FinBERT reads the news; gradient-boosted trees weigh all four and decide whether to trade.
regime_montecarlo_decision.implementationNote: Regime model: hmmlearn GaussianHMM (full covariance, regime_count states) over the one-bar log return, its realised volatility and a volume z-score (volatility_window_bars windows), standardised on the training span, fitted on the training span only; the walk uses the forward filter, never the smoother. Monte Carlo: per regime a Student-t of the one-bar log return (scipy maximum likelihood on the bars the smoothed posterior assigns it); simulation_count paths of the label horizon start from the filtered regime probabilities and re-draw the regime each bar from the transition matrix, with common random numbers. Kronos: the pretrained foundation model (kronos_model_size, pinned Hugging Face revision) reads the last kronos_context_bars candles and decodes the next horizon candles greedily. FinBERT: the nine finbert_* columns. Decision model: xgboost over the regime probabilities, the simulation's P(up), expected move and 10-90 percentile spread, Kronos' move and direction and the FinBERT columns, the regime and simulation signals of the last maximum_training_bars training rows made out of fold (stacking_fold_count blocks, each purged by the label horizon on both sides), early-stopped on validation. The trade gate opens when |P(up) - 0.5| >= decision_threshold. The price model is the simulation's expected move. Expect: regimes describe volatility well; direction is close to the base rate.
regime_montecarlo_decision.estimatedTrainingTime: 10-60 min (paced replay; Kronos reads every test bar on the GPU)

regime_count.label: Regimes
regime_count.description: How many hidden market regimes the hidden Markov model learns (regime 1 is always the calmest).

regime_fit_iteration_count.label: Regime fit iterations
regime_fit_iteration_count.description: Expectation-maximisation iterations of the hidden Markov model fit.

volatility_window_bars.label: Volatility and volume window (bars)
volatility_window_bars.description: Bars of finite one-bar returns the realised volatility is measured over, and of log volumes the volume z-score is measured against.

simulation_count.label: Simulated paths
simulation_count.description: Monte Carlo paths of the label horizon simulated at every bar from the current regime probabilities.

kronos_model_size.label: Kronos model
kronos_model_size.description: Which pretrained Kronos forecasts the next candles: mini (4.1 million parameters, fastest), small (24.7 million) or base (102.3 million).

kronos_context_bars.label: Kronos context (bars)
kronos_context_bars.description: Candles ending at the bar that Kronos reads before it forecasts the next ones.

stacking_fold_count.label: Out-of-fold blocks
stacking_fold_count.description: Contiguous blocks the stacking rows are cut into; each block's regime and simulation signals come from a regime model fitted without it (purged by the label horizon).

maximum_training_bars.label: Stacking rows
maximum_training_bars.description: The most recent training rows the decision model is fitted on (each needs a Kronos forecast and a simulation).

boosting_rounds.label: Decision model boosting rounds
boosting_rounds.description: Most boosting rounds of the decision model (early stopping ends sooner when validation stops improving).

max_depth.label: Decision model tree depth
max_depth.description: Deepest split chain of each decision tree.

decision_threshold.label: Trade gate threshold
decision_threshold.description: The decision model's P(up) must be at least this far from 0.5 for the engine to enter a trade; closer, it stands aside.
